operations.summary: List tenant users in the customer control plane
operations.description: Requires identity.users.manage in a platform scope. Platform identities are never returned.

params.name: include
params.description: Optional comma-separated unique projections. user_metadata adds remark and QQ; user_verification adds only current personal/company verification flags; platform_admins also lists platform-scope administrators (tenant_id null); Omission preserves the original fifteen-field representation. Empty, unknown, duplicate items and repeated parameters are rejected. user_verification, platform_admins and reseller are accepted only on this list endpoint.

params.name: display_id
params.description: Exact positive-decimal user display ID. Internal UUID identity and write paths are unchanged.

params.name: username
params.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of username only. Trim boundary whitespace, reject raw C0/C1 controls, and allow at most 128 Unicode code points after trimming. Empty means no filter; all supplied filters intersect using AND.

params.name: display_name
params.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of display name only, with the same trimming, control-character rejection, length and AND semantics as username. Percent and underscore are literal characters.

params.name: email
params.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of email only, with the same trimming, control-character rejection, length and AND semantics as username. Partial addresses are allowed; NULL email does not match a nonempty filter.

params.name: phone
params.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of phone only, with the same trimming, control-character rejection, length and AND semantics as username. Leading zeroes and plus signs are significant; NULL phone does not match a nonempty filter.

params.name: remark
params.description: Trimmed case-insensitive literal substring of the administrator remark. Empty means no filter; combined with every other filter using AND.

params.name: qq
params.description: Trimmed case-insensitive literal substring of the QQ contact text. Leading zeroes are significant; empty means no filter and all filters intersect.

params.name: real_name_status
params.description: Optional current verification filter, intersected with all other filters before pagination in the same snapshot as the returned flags. verified means personal_verified OR company_verified; unverified means neither. Omit for all users. Empty or unknown values are invalid. Each flag requires the latest application of that kind to be approved, its authoritative identity binding to match, and its evidence settlement to be settled. Reads never create or approve identity records.

params.name: type
params.description: reseller = the tenant has a reseller profile (active or suspended); customer = the tenant belongs to a reseller; direct = neither. Any value excludes platform administrators. Omit for all users.

params.name: parent
params.description: Owning reseller filter, applied before pagination and intersected with type. none = tenants without a reseller (platform customers, including resellers themselves); a lowercase reseller scope UUID = that reseller's customers. Excludes platform administrators. Omit for all users.

operations.summary: Replace a tenant user's login security policy
operations.description: Same primary-session authorization as GET. The policy uses its own revision, receipt and audit; it does not change users.revision or existing user-write receipts. All fields are required. Empty allowlist disables the source restriction; none disables the additional login code. Email/SMS require a bound contact and a configured enabled channel. Source restrictions apply to new password and code logins, not existing sessions, refresh or API keys. Once a policy is enabled, rolling back to a binary without the login gate is unsafe. The service never silently clears a policy to permit rollback.

operations.summary: Replace a tenant user's secondary identity verification request
operations.description: Own revision, receipt and audit; users.revision is unchanged. Switching it on records requested_at and enqueues the identity.secondary_verification email/SMS notice in the same transaction; editing an active request does not notify again. The user completes it with an approved personal_reverification created after requested_at. expiry_action lock_sites requires a deadline; when the deadline passes without completion the control plane stops the user's sites (disables and locks them, then republishes so the nodes stop serving them). Once the reverification is approved, or the request is switched off or its deadline moved into the future, exactly the changes it made are undone and the scope is republished; sites stopped or locked for other reasons are left as they are. Disabling requires deadline null and expiry_action none.
